extracted.name: Slow Cooker Cowboy Beans
extracted.description: This hearty cowboy beans recipe combines baked beans with pork, kidney beans, lima beans, and ground beef in sweet and tangy homemade barbecue sauce.
ingredient_lines: 1 (28 ounce) can baked beans with pork
1 (15 ounce) can kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 (15 ounce) can lima beans, rinsed and drained
instruction_lines: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir ground beef and bacon together in the hot skillet until beef is browned and crumbly, about 7 to 10 minutes.
Transfer hamburger and bacon into a slow cooker; stir in baked beans with pork, kidney beans, lima beans, onions, ketchup, brown sugar, and mustard.
Cover and cook on Low until thickened and bubbling, at least 3 hours.
